blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Yes! We don’t use any fire retardant c…
blocks_element.text: Yes! We don’t use any fire retardant chemicals or barriers, but the layer of wool in the mattress cover acts as a natural fire barrier. This allows our mattresses to pass all of the required federal fire tests.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Yes, our mattresses are certified orga…

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Do I need to air out the mattress?
blocks_element.text: Do I need to air out the mattress?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · No, you do not need to air out your ne…
blocks_element.text: No, you do not need to air out your new mattress. The odor of the mattress may be stronger when first opened but should dissipate to some extent with time. The reduction in odor will be most noticeable in the week after opening the package. While you can air out the mattress during this time, we urge customers to do so cautiously.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Many methods people use to air out our…
blocks_element.text: Many methods people use to air out our products actually increase the odor rather than reduce it. Placing the foam in heat or sunlight can cause the odor to drastically increase for an extended period of time and may damage the foam. If you choose to air out the mattress, we recommend doing so in a cool dark room with good ventilation.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Does the mattress need to be flipped o…
blocks_element.text: Does the mattress need to be flipped or rotated?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The mattress is designed to only be us…
blocks_element.text: The mattress is designed to only be used on one side and should not be flipped. The mattress can be rotated, if desired, but rotating the mattress at regular intervals is not necessary.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Is the mattress cover machine washable…
blocks_element.text: Is the mattress cover machine washable?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · No, the mattress cover can be removed …
blocks_element.text: No, the mattress cover can be removed but is not machine washable. We recommend only spot cleaning the mattress cover or dry cleaning the entire cover, if necessary.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · When taking the cover to be dry cleane…
blocks_element.text: When taking the cover to be dry cleaned, please specify that it is only dry clean only and cannot be machine washed – this is mentioned on our tags but we have had heard of instances where dry cleaners don’t notice.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Natural rubber is so good. But it’s mi…
blocks_element.text: Natural rubber is so good. But it’s misunderstood. This springy material comes from trees. Trees! The word rubber sounds plasticky and artificial, but it’s the most natural, breathable, durable, and sustainable material available for mattresses.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · We source our liquid rubber from a net…
blocks_element.text: We source our liquid rubber from a network of independent farmers in Sri Lanka, and we process it at our own factory nearby. To bond liquid rubber molecules into plush foam, we mix it with a small amount of sulfur, zinc oxide, accelerators, and antioxidants. Our foam has earned the most stringent organic, fair trade, and health certifications available.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Our mattresses also feature GOTS-certi…
blocks_element.text: Our mattresses also feature GOTS-certified organic wool and cotton. Our wool comes from a farmer-owned collective in New Zealand dedicated to high-quality wool, happy sheep, and sustainability. Our cotton is grown in India and Turkey without the use of pesticides or synthetic fertilizer and processed in certified organic factories in Canada, Germany, and Pakistan.
